notes: Original Schedule TO-I (offer document) for an issuer cash tender for up to 50% of common shares at 99% of NAV. Second event: the Offer to Purchase (Summary and Section 9) and the Saba agreement (doc 9, Section 1.1(f)) describe three Subsequent Conditional Tender Offers, in Q4 of each of 2022, 2023 and 2024, for up to 10% of then-outstanding shares at 98% of NAV if, from January to August of that year, the average discount to NAV exceeds 10% (volume-weighted average market price and NAV on business days). The Offer to Purchase says it does not relate to them. window_start/window_end are null because the window is stated only by month (January to August of each of 2022, 2023, 2024; doc 9 says 'from January 2022 through August 2022', and likewise for 2023 and 2024). trigger_origin/origin = activist_settlement: EVM and Saba Capital Management, L.P. entered into an agreement (doc 9, 'Agreement' dated as of May 12, 2021, filed as the standstill exhibit) under which the Board authorized the Offer and the three conditional tenders; Saba agreed not to challenge the certified results of the New Agreement vote and accepted constraints on activist activities. The Offer was also conditioned on certification of shareholder approval of the new advisory agreement after Morgan Stanley's March 1, 2021 acquisition of Eaton Vance Corp.; results certified May 12, 2021, condition met (excluded from conditions as already satisfied). conditions element 'other' is the asset-coverage condition for senior securities; market_disruption also covers the banking-moratorium and credit-limitation clauses. commencement_date from the joint press release (doc 7, June 29, 2021, 'announced today the commencement'); the Offer to Purchase is dated June 29, 2021. Expiration July 30, 2021, 5:00 p.m. Eastern, unless extended (only one date stated). Doc 9 also states: Saba may be deemed beneficial owner of 6,218,811 common shares as of May 12, 2021; the Tender Offer must commence by July 1, 2021, proceeds paid by August 13, 2021 and not before July 15, 2021; odd lots subject to the same proration; the Tender Offer is in lieu of the conditional tender offer announced by the Fund on March 16, 2021. 39,863,690 Shares outstanding as of June 23, 2021; NAV $14.5570 and closing price $14.31 on June 23, 2021.
